principle: A later epoch begins only from a qualified, frozen full-world checkpoint. Epochs separate long-horizon emergence from short mechanism development. General cognitive architecture priors are allowed, but concrete cognitive contents, subjective values, social concepts and role conclusions cannot be supplied as answers.

epochs.title: 生态承载体与分区主体图塑形
allowed_conclusions: partitioned subject-graph architecture and neutral routing validation

epochs.title: 实体主体雏形：涌现的跨时程内部动力结构

required_evidence: a nontrivial evolved internal graph state depends on delayed history
that state changes later behavior under shared-checkpoint intervention
its effect exceeds reflex, proximity, kinship, recent-event and fixed-cognition baselines
its continuation effect compensates for explicit cognitive costs
functionally equivalent structures recur across independent seeds or lineages without requiring identical representations
forbidden_substitutes: fixed semantic material or knowledge ledgers
architectural region labels treated as cognitive functions

allowed_conclusions: persistent delayed internal control of behavior
candidate interest-decision closure without prescribed semantic content

epochs.title: Group 主体雏形：规章有效化

required_evidence: shared or externalized control state arises from interacting entity subject graphs rather than copied designer policy
the shared state measurably constrains or redirects member actions
control effects persist through member turnover
group-level continuation or resource control changes when shared control state is neutralized from a common checkpoint
membership, enforcement and effective rules arise from evolved internal and inter-entity dynamics rather than group labels
